build_imagegpt_model: build an ImageGPTModel transformer with word-piece embeddings and positional embeddings for image token sequences
create_causal_image_modeling: create an ImageGPTForCausalImageModeling model with a language modeling head for unconditional image generation
run_image_classification: run image classification with ImageGPTForImageClassification by average-pooling hidden states and projecting to label logits
test_attention_forward: test the ImageGPTAttention forward pass with self-attention, cross-attention, layer past caching, and causal masking
review_mlp_forward: review the ImageGPTMLP forward pass that applies a feed-forward network with gelu activation and residual dropout
